open_bugs.description: decrampOn defaults to false and upDecrampedPeakingCoeffs is not yet integrated into AE_WORKER_SRC / aeBandCurve in src/03-autoeq-solver.js.
aeSolveObjective currently uses weighted L2 (MSE) + gain/Q penalty; Soft L1 (Huber) energy-domain loss and >10 kHz energy averaging remain open for Cycle #1+ experimentation.

tested_hypotheses.summary: Precomputed twiddle lookup table for fft() was slower/redundant vs recurrence cos/sin.
Relaxing Nelder-Mead gain/Q bounds violated safety/anti-ringing criteria.
